fields.objectives: Name the three Core Web Vitals; Know the good and poor thresholds

pages.markdown:
:::video{src="/api/assets/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005" poster="/api/assets/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006" ratio="16:9" chapters="0:00 Three numbers|0:08 Largest Contentful Paint|0:16 Layout shift and responsiveness" transcript=""}:::

| Metric | Good | Poor |
| --- | --- | --- |
| LCP | under 2.5 s | over 4 s |
| CLS | under 0.1 | over 0.25 |
| INP | under 200 ms | over 500 ms |

pages.title: Wrapping up
pages.markdown:
:::video{src="/api/assets/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005" poster="/api/assets/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006" ratio="16:9" chapters="0:00 What we fixed|0:08 A checklist|0:16 Where next" transcript=""}:::

## Checklist

1. Hero image sized, modern format, high priority.
2. Every image and embed has dimensions.
3. Fonts self-hosted with tuned fallbacks.
4. No long task over 200 ms on a mid-range phone.
5. Assets cached for a year; pages revalidated.

questions.prompt: Which metric measures how much the page jumps while it loads?
What is a good Largest Contentful Paint?
A long task is anything on the main thread longer than…
questions.explanation: Fifty milliseconds is where a tap starts to feel late.

questions.prompt: Which percentile should you fix for?
questions.explanation: The 75th percentile is a normal bad day.

questions.prompt: Which files can be cached for a year?
questions.explanation: A new version gets a new file name, so the old cache never goes stale.
